stemBlocks: The graph shows the mass of product produced over time for an enzyme-controlled reaction in two different conditions, X and Y. All other variables were kept constant.
Which of the following could be correct for this graph?

1 Condition X is a higher pH than condition Y.
2 Condition X has less substrate supplied than condition Y.
3 Condition X is a lower pH than condition Y.
4 Condition X has more substrate supplied than condition Y.

assets.alt: Graph showing mass of product produced over time for conditions X (solid line) and Y (dashed line).
